name: coding-to-production
summary: Coding agents work vulnerability tasks on GitHub: they read, branch and open pull requests; a person reviews the exact head of every merge, a release approver gates every deployment inside a change window, one merge per run, and production revisions are verified after the fact.
covers: branch and pull-request work on the named repositories, never on their default branches
an exact reviewed merge: an independent reviewer approves the merge bound to its head SHA
the deployment consequence: a release approver approves each deployment inside a change window
production revision verification through the GitHub connector's effect verification
